profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at GKeep LLC with expertise in learning solutions
profile.summary:
With over 8 years at GKeep LLC, our team has specialized in designing innovative virtual learning programs for small to medium-sized businesses. These solutions equip organizations with critical customer service skills such as communication, adaptability, and goal-oriented strategies, tailored to improve their operational success.  

At USA Security Net, we have provided strategic security consulting, supporting organizations with compliance audits, intellectual property safeguards, and policy development. By combining expertise in training program development and security assessments, we ensure businesses meet regulatory standards while safeguarding their most valuable resources.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Partner
positions.description:
• Spearheaded the development of customized virtual training programs for small to medium-sized organizations, enhancing client customer service skills.  
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate innovative learning designs, resulting in improved training engagement and effectiveness.  
• Achieved a 30% increase in client satisfaction ratings through tailored training solutions focused on essential skills such as communication and empathy.

positions.title: Director of Operations, Partner
positions.description:
USA Security Net Inc., a Colorado-based corporation, offers security consulting services for businesses. We support companies in their management activities, including daily operations, policy evaluation, and auditing procedures related to the direct handling of intellectual property.

Our audit recommendations cover a range of areas: computer usage, record management, compliance reporting, record-keeping strategies, data storage, and the development and implementation of internal training programs. This includes evaluating the current performance and effectiveness of existing physical security measures, electronic security systems, and UL monitoring services.

We have been serving the Rocky Mountain region since 1984.
